info.name: Salesforce Bulk API 2.0 Abort Messaging API

items.docs: Creates and initiates a triggered email send to one or more recipients. Each send requires a message definition key referencing a triggered send definition configured in Marketing Cloud Email Studio. Supports personalization attributes and subscriber data overrides.

Creates and initiates an SMS message send to one or more recipients. Requires a message definition key referencing an SMS definition configured in Marketing Cloud MobileConnect. Supports personalization attributes for dynamic message content.

params.name: messageKey
params.description: The unique message key (recipientSendId) returned when the email send was created.

items.docs: Retrieves the status of a triggered email send for a specific recipient using the messageKey (recipientSendId) returned when the send was created. Returns the current delivery status and any error details.
